hotkey.description: Global hotkey to trigger word lookup, e.g., 'Ctrl+Alt+Q'; empty string disables hotkey

mode.description: Initial display mode: 'simple' (flat relatives) or 'detailed' (tree-view for hierarchical relations)

notifications_enabled.description: Whether to show passive desktop notifications instead of the application window

show_familiarity.description: Whether to display word familiarity level (polysemy count) next to definitions

show_status_icon.description: Whether to show a status icon in the system tray

suggestions_enabled.description: Whether to enable spell-based suggestions for misspelled queries (requires libenchant)

dictionaries.description: List of custom dictionary file paths (WordNet .index files); empty means default WordNet only

regex_search_enabled.description: Whether to allow Wildmat-style regex patterns in search (e.g., cro*p, can????r)
